author: marketing_c
protectedRevelations: Eidon reforms, later crises, character outcomes and final civic dilemma

scenes.title: The shipment will not move
scenes.viewerPurpose: Picture needed hospital filters held up at a port Enter a future where money cannot move essentials
scenes.composition: Filter crates wait between a port and hospital request
addOrChange: Add recognizable filters and a hospital doorway without a later rescue.

cues.narration: The hospital needs filters; the port has them; valid ownership claims keep them waiting.
cues.visualAction: Keep the crate still while the competing ownership records disagree.

cues.narration: The Makers of Reality imagines a future where money can no longer keep essential goods moving.
cues.visualAction: Widen to the hospital that needs the delayed delivery.

scenes.title: Life after money
scenes.viewerPurpose: Wonder what people still compete for with enough to live Recognize time and home as deeply personal stakes
scenes.composition: A furnished home and caregiver reveal remaining scarcity
addOrChange: Replace the repeated shipment with a limited appointment book and two waiting residents.

cues.narration: This speculative novel imagines essentials available to everyone, then asks what remains scarce.
cues.visualAction: Show food and shelter available without a payment transaction.

cues.narration: A beautiful home, a caregiver’s time, and the power to shape tomorrow still provoke conflict.
cues.visualAction: The caregiver has one appointment while two people need attention.

scenes.title: Who gets to decide
scenes.viewerPurpose: Notice how useful work can bring political power Meet people trying to live inside those promises
scenes.composition: A public contributor presents a new project to affected families
addOrChange: Replace burden icon with a past contribution record and add family representatives.

cues.narration: People who solve big problems gain power over choices that affect everyone.
cues.visualAction: The contributor’s earlier achievement enters a different public decision.

cues.narration: Families and engineers must navigate a future where generosity can become political weight.
cues.visualAction: A family points to its home on the proposed plan.

scenes.title: The cost of enough
scenes.viewerPurpose: Wonder which desires abundance brings into view Ask who should choose what society builds next
scenes.composition: People in a secure home consider different future projects
addOrChange: Add two simple alternatives and leave both undecided.

cues.narration: The fascination lies in watching abundance expose desires that prices once concealed.
cues.visualAction: Keep the comfortable room steady while the preferences differ.

cues.narration: When there is enough to go around, who gets to decide what comes next?
cues.visualAction: Hold both possible projects without choosing a winner.
